description: Split strips so each serves one subsystem and/or one function: power (TB-PWR), PE (TB-PE), AC (TB-AC), field I/O per PLC module (TB-IO); the rest stays on plain TB strips. Everything tied together on a strip moves as one unit; a unit serving several subsystems goes to their common parent (shared distribution at the level above). Wires move with their terminals; device connections never change. apply=false (default) reports the plan; ask the user before applying. pack=true also re-packs the results (like optimize_strips).

strip.description: Strip tag; omit for every strip

name: split_strips
title: Split terminal strips by subsystem / function
